subject: Security exhibit redline runbook, staging window, and evidence cadence
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@healthbyte.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: d.ortiz@healthbyte.com
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HealthByte MSA redlines — security exhibit + pen test windows

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the chat this morning. We reviewed the MSA and attached security exhibit and had a few redline asks from our InfoSec and procurement teams before we can move to countersign:

- SOC 2 evidence: request for monthly extract of control mappings rather than quarterly samples (they want a shorter feedback loop).
- Pen test timing: we need a 30-day notice minimum and a defined maintenance blackout window (no tests during our quarterly release freeze).
- Audit rights: can we clarify that inspections are limited to production telemetry exposed via a read-only portal and that any full-system forensic access requires a separate SOW?
- Retention & redaction: HealthByte requires customers' log retention to be described with redaction responsibilities called out for PII.

I've attached our marked-up MSA and a short CSV with preferred pen test windows. Can your legal/security team review and confirm which of these are acceptable or propose alternative language?

We'd like to keep momentum — would appreciate a proposed playbook for evidence handoff and a 2-week turnaround on redlines if possible.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Legal Operations, HealthByte

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@healthbyte.com>
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthByte MSA redlines — security exhibit + pen test windows

Sarah — really helpful summary, and thanks for the attachments. Quick initial notes from ops/legal side below; Olga and Karthik will follow up with redline language.

High-level responses:
- SOC 2 evidence cadence: We typically provide quarterly sampling for detailed artifacts but can provide a monthly extract of control mappings (metadata only) to shorten the feedback loop. Full artifact exports monthly create risk/scale concerns — propose: monthly control mapping CSV + quarterly artifact package.

- Pen test timing & blackout windows: We can formalize a 30-day notice. Maintenance blackout windows are reasonable — please confirm the quarterly freeze dates in the CSV and we'll include a no-testing carveout.

- Inspection scope: We are open to limiting routine inspections to the read-only telemetry portal. Requests for forensic access will route through our Security & Legal teams and require an SOW plus mutually agreed sampling rules. We'll draft language that references SOW requirements.

- Retention/redaction: We need to align on shared responsibility: Redwood will redact system-internal metadata; HealthByte should flag PII requiring customer-side redaction before transfer. Olga will propose a clause.

Next steps / asks:
1) Olga/Karthik will prepare redline suggestions by EOD 2027-05-24.
2) Can HealthByte confirm team-approved quarterly freeze dates and whether monthly control mapping fields in the CSV meet your needs?
3) We can schedule a short 30-min bridge (legal + security) on 2027-05-25 to finalize the playbook.

I'll attach a draft security-exhibit playbook that outlines evidence handoff roles and timelines.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@healthbyte.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HealthByte MSA redlines — security exhibit + pen test windows

Sarah — attaching proposed redline snippets inline in the MSA and a separate short clause set you can accept/decline. Summary of the proposed positions:

1) SOC 2 evidence cadence
- Offer: "Monthly control mapping extract (CSV, metadata only) + Quarterly artifact package (SOC 2 artifacts and supporting evidence)."
- Rationale: preserves HealthByte's desire for faster visibility while protecting volume and PII concerns.

2) Pen test windows
- Proposed clause: "Vendor will provide at least thirty (30) days' notice for any penetration test. Vendor and Customer will coordinate maintenance blackout windows; tests are prohibited during Customer-designated release freeze dates. Any out-of-band forensic requests will be governed by a separate SOW."

3) Audit/inspection scope
- Proposed clause: "Routine inspections are limited to access to a read-only telemetry/operations portal and aggregated logs. Forensic or full-system access requires a written SOW, mutually agreed scope, and a security escort process. Vendor will not provide privileged administrator credentials as part of routine inspections."

4) Retention & redaction
- Proposed clause: "Vendor retains operational logs for X days (to be filled) and will apply reasonable redaction of system-internal identifiers. Customer is responsible for identifying and redacting customer-origin PII before evidence transfer. Vendor will provide an evidence checklist and redaction guide."

I've placed exact redline language in the attached doc. If HealthByte can accept the two-track approach for SOC2 (monthly metadata + quarterly artifacts) we can close this quickly.

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: HealthByte MSA redlines — security exhibit + pen test windows

Thanks — the language looks good overall and HealthByte can accept the two-track SOC 2 approach. A few quick clarifications before we sign:

- Please add maximum artifact size limits and a secure transfer method (SFTP or presigned S3) in the evidence clause.
- For the pen-test blackout: HealthByte's Q3 freeze is Aug 10–Aug 18 and Q4 freeze is Nov 14–Nov 22 — please include both in the final clause.
- On retention: HealthByte prefers retention of 90 days for operational logs sent as part of artifact packages.

If you can incorporate those three bullets into the final redline, we can aim to return a countersigned MSA the week of 2027-06-01.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to join the 30-min bridge if you want a live read.

Best,
Sarah Lewis
Head of Legal Operations, HealthByte
